requirements.xyian_official_power: XYIAN OFFICIAL — called XY for short (Guild ID 213797), the founding guild — requires 8M+ power.
requirements.projectxy_power: ProjectXY — called PXY for short (Guild ID 214890), the sister guild and the primary home for new members — requires 6M+ power.
requirements.short_names: Members use short names for both guilds: XY means XYIAN OFFICIAL and PXY means ProjectXY. A question about 'XY' is about XYIAN OFFICIAL (8M+), NOT about ProjectXY — even though ProjectXY's full name also contains the letters XY. A question about 'PXY' is about ProjectXY (6M+). Use the short names naturally in replies, the way members do.
